decisions.statement: How the money moved is a merchant here for rows whose words name no vendor.
A merchant a rule names is a merchant here.
A row matching no merchant is read as `unstated`.

definition: who or what a transaction was with, read out of the words it carries

directives.name: The Words That Survive
directives.act: Take a merchant's patterns from the bank's own text rather than from Monarch's title.
directives.warrant: A title is Monarch's rewrite of the bank's line and changes without warning; the line never does.
aids: Never add the title as an extra pattern.
Copy the run exactly, abbreviations and all.
